commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Jean Butez pulls off a great save to deny Alex Sala (Lecce), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
90+3' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Olaf Gorter (Lecce) replacing Ylber Ramadani.
90+1' Substitution. Nico Paz did his best and is replaced by Andrea Le Borgne (Como).
90+1' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) jumps into a tackle and Matteo Marchetti signals a foul. Lecce are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
89' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
87' Alex Sala (Lecce) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
84' Marco Cassetti has decided to make a change. Martin Baturina (Como) replaces Mergim Vojvoda.
83' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' The game is interrupted. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Sala (Lecce) replaces Santiago Pierotti.
79' The game has come to an end for Riccardo Sottil. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).
78' Here is a change. Diego Carlos is going off and Marco Cassetti gives the last tactical orders to Marc Oliver Kempf (Como).
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jesus Rodriguez as he is replaced by Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como).
75' 0 - 3 Anastasios Douvikas (Como) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets low into the middle of the goal.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Como comes to nothing.
74' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
74' Alberto Moreno (Como) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
72' The linesman raises his flag. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is adjudged offside.
71' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Maximo Perrone (Como), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
69' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Youssef Maleh will be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
69' Here comes a substitution. Nikola Stulic is given a rest as he is replaced by Francesco Camarda (Lecce).
66' 0 - 2 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Mergim Vojvoda and Jacobo Ramon (Como) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 0:2.
65' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and makes a call.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.

62' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Como will take a corner.
60' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick!
59' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
58' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
56' Diego Carlos (Como) sees a yellow card from Matteo Marchetti after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
55' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' A cross from a corner kick by Lecce is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
54' Jean Butez (Como) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
54' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after the corner and unleashes a shot which flies well wide of the right post.
54' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' The corner is swung in but Como can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' Nico Paz (Como) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Corner kick. Como will have an opportunity.
50' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

48' Alberto Moreno (Como) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marchetti with no other option than to blow for a foul.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Cassetti probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ivan Smolcic (Como). He is replaced by Ignace Van der Brempt.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' The foul by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) was seen by Matteo Marchetti who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45+1' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jesus Rodriguez (Como), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
43' Alberto Moreno (Como) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the left side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Wladimiro Falcone.
42' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for an infringement.
39' Ivan Smolcic (Como) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
39' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
39' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The referee blows his whistle, Como are awarded a corner kick.

38' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Wladimiro Falcone, who pulls off a stunning save! Como have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Jamil Siebert (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Ivan Smolcic (Como) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
29' Diego Carlos (Como) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
27' It looks like Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) saw red with that tackle. Matteo Marchetti won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
26' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ylber Ramadani (Lecce). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
24' Eusebio Di Francesco is stunned as referee Matteo Marchetti shows him a RED CARD.
23' Diego Carlos (Como) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
22' The main referee, Matteo Marchetti, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is given a yellow card for dissent.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Nico Paz (Como) shoots from distance and his effort takes a nick off the defender and goes past Wladimiro Falcone. 0:1.
17' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) is adjudged offside.
12' Dangerous play by Jesus Rodriguez (Como). Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Nico Paz (Como) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
8' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
7' Nico Paz (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matteo Marchetti no option but to blow his whistle.
3' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
2' Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul after Jesus Rodriguez (Como) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Matteo Marchetti.
